methodology: Maker/manufacturer documented specs; public list prices are not landed prices; video project options are not mechanically or firmware interchangeable.

options.name: MacDesk Buddy — separate ESP32-S3 and GC9A01 round IPS
options.hardware: ESP32-S3 N16R8 + Otronic GC9A01 OT8724 + optional MPU-6050

price.covers: complete planned Otronic basket, tracked Finland shipping included

options.recommendation: Supported cheapest learning baseline; choose if you want to wire components and learn SPI/I2C.

options.name: Waveshare 1.28 inch GC9A01 IPS with supplied 8-pin cable
options.hardware: Waveshare LCD Module SKU 19192 plus separate ESP32-S3

price.covers: display module only; no VAT/delivery or MCU

options.software: driver-family match, but pin names, BLK and CAD dimensions require checks
options.solder_free: supplied PH2.0 8-pin cable; cable termination at controller still required
options.recommendation: Worth the premium if connector certainty matters more than the absolute lowest display price.

options.name: Physical Taby round — Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.32
options.hardware: Integrated ESP32-S3 + display + microphone + audio interface; separate speaker may be needed

price.covers: development board only, no international shipping/taxes

options.software: Official Taby firmware supports exact 1.32 board (target round-1.32); not compatible with this repo's GC9A01 build
options.mechanical: Official Taby round printable case still listed as coming soon
options.solder_free: integrated screen; external peripherals use expansion connectors
options.recommendation: Most attractive creator-matched compact option for experimenting with an already working expressive UI.

options.name: Physical Taby 1.64 rectangular AMOLED — exact V1
options.software: Official Taby supports only exact V1; V2 not supported (2026-10-26)
options.mechanical: Official STL/3MF files available for 1.64 case
options.recommendation: Best ready-made creator-aligned alternative with printable case, if rectangular look is acceptable.

options.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.43
options.hardware: Integrated ESP32-S3, 8MB PSRAM, 16MB flash, IMU and RTC; case variant exists

price.covers: manufacturer entry price; exact option and shipping extra

options.software: Waveshare SDK examples; NOT an official Taby supported board, requires separate project/firmware
options.mechanical: version with CNC case available as alternate option
options.recommendation: Higher-spec custom display platform if you're ready to develop custom firmware instead of cloning our GC9A01 code.

options.name: M5Stack StackChan K151
options.visual: 2 inch color touchscreen and animated robot head
options.hardware: Assembled CoreS3 robot; camera, 2 microphones, speaker, sensors, servos, battery
options.software: Manufacturer-supported StackChan ecosystem; not the repo's GC9A01 firmware
options.recommendation: Best immediate fully embodied reference; higher cost and less hands-on electronics learning.

options.name: Rocky V1/V2 DIY camera-and-servo desk robot
options.hardware: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense, camera+mic, 2 servos, amplifier, speaker, display

price.covers: rough V2 parts estimate from creator; paid print/board bundle, tools and taxes extra

options.software: MIT code, version-specific build; V1 video matches release v1.0
options.mechanical: Creator offers separate paid V2 3D/CAD bundle
options.recommendation: Best later step for motors, camera, speech and mechatronics after the first display/sensor build.

access_notes: Reel 02/06 Mac AI Buddy requires separate BOM and lacks a publicly specified reuse license as reviewed; study/link rather than copy.
Reel 04 Neo Deskimon offers paid printable character/software resources; reproduction not open-source assumed.
Reel 08 OOMWOO ROS2 robot vacuum is simulation-ready but physical build not ready; avoid purchasing unvalidated vacuum parts.
Reel 01 Atticus is macOS agent software, not desk hardware.
